_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); revenue, net-to-gross, expense, receivables and operating-margin signals with Visa's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'Visa is a global payments technology company that enables fast, secure and reliable electronic payments across more than 200 countries and territories.' 'Our business is affected by overall economic conditions and consumer spending.' 'We face intense competition in our industry.'; no 10-K calls the business cyclical (the economy and spending are a 'why', not the company's own label: the LOW, SHW and JPM reading), so the kind is DURABLE; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a payments network on these dates, so the watch list is empty

classification.quality_note: 'Visa is a global payments technology company that enables fast, secure and reliable electronic payments across more than 200 countries and territories.' 'Our business is affected by overall economic conditions and consumer spending.' 'We face intense competition in our industry.'; no 10-K calls the business cyclical (the economy and spending are a 'why', not the company's own label: the LOW, SHW and JPM reading), so the kind is DURABLE; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a payments network on these dates, so the watch list is empty. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 13.10x; +88% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -2.45; conservative 2yr -24%.

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY09-FY17, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +12.0%/yr (Q1 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 9.4-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +20.7%/yr (FY09-FY17 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +26.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY09-FY17, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: V (retrospective, 2018-03-09) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 13.10x (55.6% downside to Bear $55.33 / +4.2% upside to Bull $129.79) | Adj composite 1.32 vs market 3.77: gap -2.45 [OVERVALUED] | +88% above the EPP floor $66.12 (19x FY18E $3.48) | Conservative 2-yr case: -24.2% total (-12.1%/yr) | At 35.8x FY18E the 15% hurdle price $164.66 sits above the BULL case; revenue +9.0% YoY in Q1 FY18, forward revenues +9% (Q1 FY18 revenue growth (no FY18 revenue range)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
